name: sketchgen
description: SketchGen — draw a rough sketch and generate a styled illustration from it with AI
author: Filip Lindström

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently -k "npm run dev" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5177 && cross-env NODE_ENV=development electron ."
scripts.electron:pack: node scripts/prepare-electron-build.mjs && npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --dir
scripts.electron:build: node scripts/prepare-electron-build.mjs && npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs
scripts.electron:build:win: node scripts/prepare-electron-build.mjs && npm run build:electron && node scripts/run-electron-builder.mjs --win
